detail: Phase run-park completed: only listed assertions passed. Other UAT cases remain Not Run.

checkpoints.name: identity
checkpoints.description: Expected account authenticated, onboarding complete, real public UID verified

checkpoints.name: run-environment
checkpoints.description: park selected; quest lookup finished before start; absent quest data reported separately

checkpoints.name: park-gps-ready
checkpoints.description: Park countdown has passed the app real-GPS-first-fix gate; waited at least five seconds with real timer before finish

checkpoints.name: run-summary
checkpoints.description: Summary shows 0.00 km from real Park GPS; feedback incomplete so Submit disabled

checkpoints.name: run-feedback
checkpoints.description: RPE/stress selected, good mood and no pain; Submit enabled

checkpoints.name: run-reward
checkpoints.description: Displayed coin reward matches actual server coin increase

checkpoints.name: run-stats
checkpoints.description: Exactly one new completed session; stored feedback correct; Stats totals match API and new history row is visible

checkpoints.name: run-history-detail
checkpoints.description: New park history detail opened after loading real session data

checkpoints.name: run-ranking
checkpoints.description: Ranking API returns Thai weekly period, descending Top 50 and own distance including new run; screen opened (partial UAT-03-020)

scope: Real Park GPS acquisition, wait at least five seconds before finishing; no injected distance or location. Checks start/pause/resume/finish, feedback, reward consistency, stats/history and ranking. Stationary Park distance may be zero; this does not establish GPS distance accuracy. Other UAT cases remain Not Run.
